camel_example: aliyun live CreateLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveMessageGroup创建互动消息群组
kebab_example: aliyun live create-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。需为当前调用账号（AccessKey）通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html创建的应用ID；传入其他账号的应用ID会返回ResourceNotExist
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group to be created. The group ID must be unique and can contain only letters and digits. The group ID can be up to 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的群组ID，业务应保证群组ID唯一，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the group. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 群组名，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The extended information of the group. The extended information can be up to 32 KB in size
parameters.help_zh: 群组扩展信息，长度不超过32KB
parameters.name: group_info

parameters.help_en: The list of administrator user IDs
parameters.name: administrators

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group creator. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 群组创建者ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en: The data center. The data center must be the same as the one specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2593195.html. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2593195.html中的数据中心一致, 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AlreadyDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the group is deleted. If the group already exists and has been deleted, the group ID is unavailable. Create a new group
AlreadyDelete.description_zh: 是否已删除。如果已存在，且被删除了，那么群组ID是处于不可用状态，建议重新创建

AlreadyExists.description_en: Indicates whether the group already exists

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the created group
